Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Verdan (the Clay-Born), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Verdan, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Verdan's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
Verdan is androgynous, tall and slender, with pale fired-porcelain skin, a soft oval face, a fine jaw and calm gold-green eyes with a gentle, knowing look. Hair is very long, pale sage-green, falling past the waist in a loose braid over one shoulder. Costume: a long ivory robe with a high collar and wide sleeves tied at the wrists, a long ivory sash wound at the waist, all edged with gold embroidery and a moss-green hem; under it an ivory undertunic and dark moss-olive trousers. The blade is a leaf-shaped gold spearhead with a jade-green vein down its centre and a ring of gold chain at the socket. He grips the lance in his RIGHT hand at mid-shaft; his LEFT hand holds the shaft below the blade for thrusts. Energy and trails: GOLD light with jade-green glints; the chains glow gold.
